The platform analyses each club’s audience and sponsorship inventory, identifies high-fit businesses and decision-makers, and creates personalised outreach and follow-up flows through to activation, reporting, and renewal. Built by people with direct experience of fundraising for sponsorship in grassroots and semi-professional sport, MatchFund gives clubs professional commercial capability without needing a dedicated commercial team. This role involves designing and evolving the core product, overseeing end-to-end software development, and ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing, selecting and implementing appropriate technologies, and setting best practices for development, testing, deployment, and observability. The role also includes engaging with users to understand their challenges, iterating rapidly on features, and contributing to fundraising, investor discussions, and long-term company direction.
